collection.title: Rover 400 Hatchback 1995 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Rover 400 Hatchback 1995 to 1999 model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
